contract.objective_labels: Frozen alternating close-reversal 5% and 9% labels; exact extreme date, not later confirmation date
contract.one_to_one: One formal-start alert to at most one same-direction same-scale pivot, and conversely. No cross-task pooling. Earliest lexicographic maximum-cardinality assignment.
contract.duplicates_against_used_pivot: Unmatched, never counted as another hit
contract.latest_incomplete_events: PENDING with explicit count, never silently deleted
contract.maturity_policy: Preserved from existing frozen baseline, not optimized for the 7-day score
contract.source_release_time_requirement: Every used raw datum must have certified publication/first availability no later than actual decision time; simply shifting to D-1 is insufficient
contract.model_training_labels: May enter training only after their confirmation/availability cutoff; exclude split-boundary overlapping outcomes
contract.blind_validation: Freeze rules first, evaluate subsequently unseen prospective evidence separately; no claim on repeatedly studied history
contract.top_bottom_alert_alternation: Not imposed: user requested one-to-one matching. Suppressing a previously issued same-side alert retrospectively is forbidden.
